Guha points out that governments have repeatedly failed to address India’s environmental crisis despite having access to scientific expertise. items.title: A Fundamental Right
items.summary: With its new law that makes education a fundamental right with effect from April 1, 2010, India joins a small group of countries with such a statutory provision. All children in the 6 to 14 age group can exercise the right under the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009. An estimated one crore children who do not go to school now are expected to benefit.

Karnataka HC dismisses MLA Yatnal's plea to quash defamation case filed by Congress MLA Patil
items.summary: The Karnataka High Court on Thursday refused to quash a criminal defamation case filed against expelled BJP MLA Basanagouda Ramangouda Patil Yatnal over remarks he made against Congress MLA Shivananda S Patil during a media interview broadcast on the YouTube channel of Gadinada Kranti on April 30, 2025. Justice Anant Ramanath Hegde dismissed a plea filed by Yatnal challenging the criminal proceedings. In doing so, the Court rejected Yatnal's argument that the trial court had erred in taking cognisance of Patil's complaint without first examining a witness who could speak to whether Patil’s reputation had been lowered in that witness's estimation. The High Court held that, at the stage of taking cognisance, a magistrate need not invariably insist on examining a witness other than the complainant to establish that the complainant's reputation has been lowered in the witness's estimation.
